title: The ras-related protein RAB22A interacts with hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1alpha) in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells in hypoxia.
authors: Papanikolaou, Nikolaos A; Kakavoulia, Maria; Ladias, Christos; Papavassiliou, Athanasios G
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和免疫共沉淀研究HIF-1α与RAB22A蛋白间的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA，且方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟仅作辅助，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Recent studies suggest that hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1alpha) and the small GTPase protein Ras-related protein Rab-22 A (RAB22A) may be colocalized in the cytoplasm and that as a conequence they may enhance the formation of microvesicles in breast cancer cells under hypoxia. Therefore, we sought to determine whether these two proteins are present in intracellular complexes in breast carcinoma cells. METHODS AND RESULTS: Evaluation using molecular docking indicated that HIF-1alpha and RAB22A interact with each other. Co-immunoprecipitation of endogenous or ectopically expressed HIF-1alpha and RAB22A proteins in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells or HEK-293T cells demonstrated that endogenous HIF-1alpha and RAB22A can form an intracellular complex; however, transiently expressed HIF-1alpha and RAB22A failed to interact. Investigating RAB22A and HIF-1alpha interactions in various cancer cell lines under hypoxia may shed light on their roles in cancer cell survival and progression through regulation of intracellular trafficking by HIF-1alpha under hypoxic conditions. CONCLUSIONS: Our study is the first to reveal the potential involvement of HIF-1alpha in intracellular trafficking through physical interactions with the small GTPase protein RAB22A. We discuss the implications of our work on the role of exosomes and microvesicles in tumor invasiveness.
abstract_zh: 背景：近期研究表明，缺氧诱导因子1-α（HIF-1alpha）和小GTP酶蛋白Ras相关蛋白Rab-22 A（RAB22A）可能在细胞质中共定位，并因此可能在缺氧条件下增强乳腺癌细胞中微泡的形成。因此，我们旨在确定这两种蛋白是否在乳腺癌细胞中形成细胞内复合物。方法与结果：使用分子对接评估表明，HIF-1alpha和RAB22A相互交互。在MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞或HEK-293T细胞中对内源性或外源性表达的HIF-1alpha和RAB22A蛋白进行共免疫沉淀，结果表明内源性HIF-1alpha和RAB22A可以形成细胞内复合物；然而，瞬时表达的HIF-1alpha和RAB22A未能交互。在缺氧条件下研究各种癌细胞系中RAB22A和HIF-1alpha的交互，可能揭示它们在癌细胞存活和进展中的作用，通过HIF-1alpha在缺氧条件下调节细胞内运输。结论：我们的研究首次揭示了HIF-1alpha通过与小GTP酶蛋白RAB22A的物理交互可能参与细胞内运输。我们讨论了我们的工作对外泌体和微泡在肿瘤侵袭性中作用的启示。
